card.name: Punctuation ending dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Commas and periods that end a clause in administration or missed-dose instructions, just before a 'do not' or 'discard' type sentence. Also 'dose' or 'dosage' after 'total daily'.

modes.label: Inspection and discard
modes.description: Comma or period after a visual check condition, right before an instruction to discard or not use.
modes.example: If any of these are present<<,>> discard the vial.

modes.label: Missed dose rules
modes.description: Period closing the instruction to take the next dose at the regular time.
modes.example: skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the next scheduled time<<.>> Vomited Dose If vomiting occurs

modes.label: Total daily dose
modes.description: The word dose or dosage after 'total daily'.
modes.example: The total daily<< dosage>> may be increased to 300

card.writes: It pushes toward 'slice' and 'cut' words and away from some odd code-like pieces, which suggests little useful output effect.
card.plain: It fires at the punctuation that ends a dosing or inspection instruction, just before the next rule such as discard or do not take.
